title: Corrigibility Protocol: an assessment instrument for digital public infrastructure
description:
A machine-readable protocol and JSON schemas for assessing whether an infrastructure system is corrigible: whether the people it affects can detect error, signal harm, and trigger correction without incurring material loss.

It operationalises five tests — EXIT, CODE, AUDIT, GOVERN, FORK — into an instrument an auditor can complete against a real deployment, rather than a framework that must be reinterpreted for each assessment. Protocol 4.0 is a breaking revision with no backward compatibility with 3.x.

The reasoning behind the tests is in two companion papers, linked below. This repository is the instrument; the papers are the argument.
